question: Who among the following discovered the Microwave?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Percy Spencer**__.

__
 
• American engineer **Percy Spencer credited with inventing the modern microwave oven from radar technology.**
 
• **Electromagnetic waves of wavelength range 10⁻³ m to 10⁻² m are called microwaves.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

 
• **Microwave Oven:**

 
 
• An electric oven that heats and cooks food by exposing it to electromagnetic radiation in the microwave frequency range.
 
• Microwave ovens use radio waves, set at a specific frequency of 2,450 megahertz with a power ranging from 500 to 1,100 watts.
 
• Food that sits in a microwave oven is bombarded on all sides by the microwaves.
